title: The farm sold and their father's businesses
summary: Their father sold the land and moved to Decatur, opening a restaurant, barber shop and grocery.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What happened to the land since your parents owned it?
They sold the land. They sold everything.
And where did he move to?
She can take over from there.
We moved to Atlanta, well, Decatur is six miles, a suburb of Atlanta. They bought a home out in Decatur.
When he sold it, how much do you think he sold it for? Do you have any ideas?
I really don't know. But, Dad, he came to Atlanta. He opened up a restaurant and a barber shop. store And a grocery store on the corner.
In this little town. He had most of the, about half of the street in this little town. But, the barber shop was in Atlanta.
Where did he get the groceries from? Did he grow his own groceries? Did he stock his store?
I know but I mean when you moved to Decatur.
I guess he bought it ... like you do now.
